title: Section 23 — To what Court application lies — CPC 1908

content.heading: To what Court application lies
content.text: Where the several Courts having jurisdiction are subordinate to the same Appellate Court, an application under Section 22 shall be made to the Appellate Court. Where they are subordinate to different Appellate Courts but to the same High Court, the application lies to that High Court. Where they are subordinate to different High Courts, the application lies to the High Court within the local limits of whose jurisdiction the Court in which the suit is brought is situate.
